external_entities.name: Supplier
external_entities.description: An external supplier that uploads compliance paperwork and signs in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: Category manager
external_entities.description: A category manager who reviews uploaded paperwork and approves or rejects it.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: Vendor
external_entities.description: The SaaS vendor that hosts the portal and pushes the nightly supplier data extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

processes.name: Supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload compliance paperwork and category managers review and approve or reject it.

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: A service in the cloud account that loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in the organisation's cloud account where the vendor's nightly supplier data extract arrives.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_stores.notes: The runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: A database in the organisation's cloud account containing supplier records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: A supplier uploads compliance paperwork, including insurance certificates, food safety audits, and staff contact details, to the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A supplier signs in to the portal using vendor-issued credentials.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers sign in with a username and password that the vendor issues to them.

data_flows.name: review and approve or reject
data_flows.description: A category manager reviews uploaded paperwork and approves or rejects it in the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded compliance paperwork and approval or rejection information

data_flows.name: push supplier data extract
data_flows.description: The portal or vendor platform pushes the nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: The source describes the vendor as pushing the extract, while the portal is the vendor's platform. The extract is said to be encrypted end to end, but the runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is; encryption in transit is therefore unresolved.
data_flows.data_description: Nightly supplier data extract in CSV format

data_flows.name: load extract
data_flows.description: The supplier master service reads the supplier data extract from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database

trust_boundaries.name: Vendor hosting
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-controlled hosting environment where the SaaS portal runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: Our cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier document portal presents a web interface because the source calls it a portal.
assumptions.basis: The source describes the system as a supplier document portal.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket contains confidential data because it stores supplier data extracts containing personal staff contact details and business compliance records.
assumptions.basis: The source states that supplier extracts contain supplier records and staff contact details, and that the extract is placed in the landing bucket.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database contains confidential data because it stores supplier records derived from compliance paperwork and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the supplier master service writes supplier records into the supplier database.
